constraints.explanation: The path must start exactly at the given start point and end exactly at the given goal point.
All path waypoints must lie within the rectangular map defined by width and height, i.e., coordinates between 0 and width/height.

The path must maintain at least safety_distance clearance from all static obstacles (circles). A collision penalty is incurred if distance from an obstacle center is less than obstacle radius plus safety_distance.
All path waypoint coordinates must be finite numbers (no NaN or infinity).
The number of waypoints in the path (including start and goal) must not exceed max_waypoints.

description: The UAV must plan a safe path from start to goal in a 2D environment with static circular obstacles and rectangular risk zones. The path must stay within map bounds, maintain at least safety_distance clearance from all obstacles, and avoid or minimize exposure to risk zones weighted by per-zone risk weights. The global objective combines path length, collision penalties (applied if clearance distance is violated), smoothness (turning angle penalties), risk exposure (local risk-zone weight times time spent in zone), and waypoint count. The objective_weights are global multipliers for each term. Finite coordinates and a maximum number of waypoints (max_waypoints) are required.
objective: Minimize the weighted sum of: global weight length * total path length; global weight collision * total collision penalty; global weight smoothness * total smoothness penalty; global weight risk * total risk exposure (sum over risk zones of local zone weight * time spent in zone); global weight waypoint * number of waypoints.
output: A feasible start-to-goal path as ordered 2D waypoints, represented as a list of [x, y] coordinate pairs.
